title: India's chip industry just had its busiest funding year yet.

sources.text: SEMI.org - Hon'ble PM Shri Narendra Modi to inaugurate SEMICON India 2026 on 17th September
DIGITIMES, 2026 - SEMICON India 2026 funding data: Indian semiconductor equity funding at multi-year high

caption:
India's chip industry just had its busiest funding year yet.

The fifth edition of SEMICON India opens September 17 at Yashobhoomi, Dwarka, running through September 19 - over 600 exhibitors, roughly 300 international, delegations from 40+ countries.

It follows July 2026's approval of 'Semicon 2.0' - a ₹1,27,500 crore outlay building on Semicon 1.0's projects across Gujarat, Assam, Uttar Pradesh, Punjab, Odisha and Andhra Pradesh.

India's semiconductor demand is projected to double from roughly $100 billion to $200 billion. The funding pace suggests investors are betting that build-out happens well before that ceiling is reached.
